english.title: Drive vehicle / ride cycle fail to observe / obey signals / instructions by PC / authorised officer - Mersey Tunnels
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels' approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_

english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(b) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a vehicle within the Mersey Tunnels / approaches / marshalling areas OR
being a cyclist in the Queensway Tunnel / on the approaches to the Queensway Tunnel
failed to observe and obey a signal / an instruction given
by a Mersey Tunnels police officer / other authorised officer
